children.title: 3-3 Mixture Problems (9/25-26)
Notes & Assignment
children.content:
Hello All,

Well, my back has totally gone out, so I am probably out for the rest of the week. . .hoping to get an MRI soon.  UGH!

Please lock in and get your lesson done and let's keep moving on!  Please help teach each other when someone gets stuck.  You can do this!

1.  Please work through the notes. . .work through the examples linked here on your blank notes page and engage your brain so that you are really comprehending.  LINK TO FILLED OUT NOTES.

2.  Please use your own paper (there is extra paper in the back) to do the ASSIGNMENT.  Please number problems on your paper and make it NEAT so that someone else can read it when grading.

Thanks Y'all!  Sorry I'm not there, but I trust you to do the right thing!

Hope to see you soon,

Bad Habetz :-)
